svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a blank 300 x 162 mm from 2 mm galvanized sheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold to a U: back 40 mm wide outside, two sides 65 mm deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold in a sheet folder or over a hardwood block in the vice.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 20 x 20 mm notch at the foot of the side that faces the road,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: against the back: the cable comes out of the sidewalk cover here.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File every edge smooth; paint the cut edges with zinc paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: open side against the pole, the free edges of both sides bearing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the pole; it stands on the sidewalk beside the pole, 300 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two marker band clamps go round it and hold it (pin-Torx security screws).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the free edges touch the pole along their whole length.
